context: A dad and his young son talk about their favorite stadium and player
purpose: Teach: スタジアム/最強/青春/最大限/前進/レッド/強度/失う

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、今度のホームスタジアム、いつ連れて行ってくれるの？
lines.en: Dad, when are you taking me to the home stadium next?
lines.style: Excited young boy tugging at his dad's sleeve, eager and hopeful tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 来月だよ。父さんの青春時代から応援してるチームだからな。
lines.en: Next month. I've supported that team since my youth.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic dad voice, smiling as he remembers his younger days.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 10番の選手、最強だよね！絶対ゴール決めるよ。
lines.en: The number 10 player is the strongest, right! He'll definitely score.
lines.style: Childlike admiration, bouncing with energy, completely sure of his hero.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、彼は毎試合、最大限の力を出してるな。本当に尊敬できる選手だ。
lines.en: Yeah, he gives his maximum every match. Truly a player to respect.
lines.style: Calm fatherly admiration, speaking with genuine respect for an athlete.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でもこの前、レッドカードもらって退場しちゃったよね…悲しかった。
lines.en: But last time he got a red card and was sent off... it was sad.
lines.style: Child's voice dropping, disappointed and a little worried recalling the moment.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そうだな。あの試合は強度が高すぎて、冷静さを失う瞬間もあったんだ。
lines.en: True. The intensity was too high in that match; he lost his composure for a moment.
lines.style: Thoughtful dad explaining gently, treating the child as old enough to understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあ次の試合は大丈夫かな？勝ってほしい！
lines.en: Then will he be okay next match? I want them to win!
lines.style: Anxious child seeking reassurance, then bouncing back with cheerful hope.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 大丈夫さ。チームは一歩ずつ前進してる。今シーズンはきっといい結果が出るよ。
lines.en: He'll be fine. The team is moving forward step by step. This season will surely bring good results.
lines.style: Reassuring dad tone, confident and steady, putting a hand on his son's shoulder.
